item.title: Column: The everyday philosophy of supply chain resilience
item.summary: When people talk about responding to supply chain shocks, the instinct is often to stockpile inventory or build backup production lines. However, after visiting Inner Mongolia Shuangjie Saidu Electric with a delegation in June 2026, I came away with a different understanding: true "supply chain resilience" is not created through last-minute crisis fixes. It is embedded in factory layout, product design, business diversification, and service models.
